{{Top|leg}}
'''Polarized droptacs''' were eyewear designed to allow users to see normally through bright lighting.<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Holojournalist/Legends|holojournalist]] [[Den Dhur]] wore polarized droptacs and a [[sonic dampener]] to protect his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and [[Ear/Legends|ears]] when he went to the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] of the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Units]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]], which had bright lights and loud music.<ref name="MedStar I" />
